# Prospects every brand has

The relationship inventory (skill move 2) starts here. Each line is a place
that already has a reason to link, or a channel that produces links for
expertise. Copy the relevant rows into `outputs/<site>/link-prospects.csv`
with a named contact and the exact URL you want linked.

Link type key: **F** followed · **N** nofollow · **M** mention/entity only.

## Entity anchors (do all of these; every one goes into Organization `sameAs`)

| Target | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Wikidata item for the organisation and each founder | F | Any organisation with two independent references qualifies. Fill `official website`, `inception`, `founded by`, `headquarters`, `industry`, social handles. This is the entity AI engines resolve against. |
| Crunchbase organisation profile | N | Claim it; add founders, funding, website. Widely scraped into AI training and answer indexes. |
| Tracxn (India) | N | Same as Crunchbase for Indian coverage. |
| LinkedIn company page, Website field | N | Also a "Featured" link on each founder's profile. |
| GitHub organisation profile | F | Only if the brand ships code, profiles or data. |
| Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect | M | Same NAP, character for character. |
| YouTube channel "About" links | N | Up to 5 links. |

## Money and mentorship

| Target | Type | Ask |
|---|---|---|
| Each investor's portfolio page | F | "Please add our logo and site to the portfolio page" — most already have a template |
| Incubator / accelerator alumni page | F | Alumni pages are rarely maintained; offer the paragraph and the logo |
| Grant or scheme beneficiary lists (DST, NIDHI, state missions, ministry schemes) | F | Government beneficiary pages exist for accountability; ask the programme office |
| University tech-transfer / entrepreneurship cell "startups from here" page | F | The alma mater wants the story |

## Registries (India first; add the country's equivalents)

| Target | Type | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Startup India (DPIIT recognition) public profile | N | Also unlocks government tenders and press "DPIIT-recognised" phrasing |
| GeM seller catalogue | N | Product pages are indexed; the entity is what counts |
| State startup portals (Karnataka, Telangana T-Hub, Tamil Nadu StartupTN, etc.) | F/N | Showcase pages link out |
| Industry bodies the brand belongs to (CII, FICCI, NASSCOM, sector associations) | F | Member directories |
| Professional councils / licensing registers | M | No link, but the entity check engines run |
| Trade marketplaces (IndiaMART, TradeIndia, ExportersIndia) | N | Nofollow, but the most-scraped B2B mentions in India |

## Journalist request platforms (make one profile per founder)

| Platform | URL | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Qwoted | qwoted.com | Closest to old HARO; journalists, podcasts, newsletters |
| Source of Sources | sourceofsources.com | Peter Shankman's free HARO successor; honour system, pitch off-topic and you're out |
| Featured (owns the HARO name since Apr 2025) | featured.com | Daily digest; answers become quotes with links |
| Help a B2B Writer | helpab2bwriter.com | B2B trade writers |
| #journorequest on X / Bluesky | — | Search daily; reply within the hour |

Overlap between any two of these is ~17 %: watch at least three.

## Press that runs founder and company stories (India)

National business/startup: YourStory, Inc42, Economic Times, Mint, Business
Standard, The Hindu BusinessLine, Financial Express, Moneycontrol, Forbes
India, Fortune India, ET Now / CNBC-TV18 web desks.
City editions are the easy first win: Deccan Herald and Bangalore Mirror
(Bengaluru), Telangana Today, Deccan Chronicle and The Hans India
(Hyderabad), The Hindu metro editions, Times of India city pages.
Trade press: see the vertical file.
Rule: pitch one outlet at a time, exclusive first, with a picture and a
number in the subject line.

## Events, awards, speaking

Every exhibitor list, speaker page, jury page and award shortlist is a
followed link on a relevant domain. Log each event the brand attends as a
prospect; ask the organiser for the listing URL before the event.

## Founders' own footprints

Alma mater alumni features, department "notable alumni" pages, conference
bios, podcast guest pages, book/chapter author pages, standards and
committee memberships, guest lecture announcements on college sites.

## Communities engines read

Reddit (the most-cited domain across AI engines — city subs, vertical subs),
Quora, Stack Exchange sites for the field, LinkedIn groups, Discord and
Telegram communities of the vertical. Participation rules are in the skill.

## Review platforms engines cite

Google reviews, Trustpilot, G2/Capterra (software), Justdial, Practo
(health), TripAdvisor (travel), Amazon (products). Profiles with real
reviews have roughly 3× the AI-citation rate of brands without. Never
incentivise a review.

## Unlinked-mention reclamation

Google Alerts + Talkwalker Alerts for: brand name, founders' names, product
names, common misspellings. For every hit that names without linking: one
email with the exact URL. This is the cheapest followed link that exists.

## Wikipedia

Only when the brand has sustained, independent coverage. Never write your
own article; assemble the sources and request one via the relevant
WikiProject. Wikidata (above) is always fine.
